text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding MixtralX-7B variant hit a perf regression in nightly perf runs, looks related to rotary/kv dims.
ajay: saw the alert, profile trace points to kernel selection thrashing between fast-gemm and fallback for forward pass.
kevin: dump from perf-bot shows lots of small batches + repeated KV evictions, latency spike ~3-4x on 512 seq.
maria: here's the short profile snippet:
```
PerfBot: kernel_select: mixtralx7b.bin -> selected kernel: fast_gemm (80%) then fallback (20%)
KVCache: eviction_count=1245, avg_kv_size=2.1MB, hit_rate=0.67
Latency P50: 48ms -> P95: 410ms
```
sophie: interesting — why would KV evictions be high? is rope_scale parsed correctly from hf config? we had a similar case where rotary_dim was missing.
eli: I inspected the safetensors metadata, it lacks "rotary_scaling" and axes look like (heads, head_dim) vs our expectation, so our HF parser defaulted to rotary_dim=heads*hidden/heads and set rope_scale=1.0 incorrectly.
ajay: that can cause mismatched kv dim math -> kernel expects kv dim multiple of 64 and falls back if not aligned.
kevin: repro steps I used:
```
# convert and load locally
python tools/convert_safetensors.py \
  --in models/mixtralx7b.safetensors \
  --out tmp/converted.pt \
  --fix-axes
python perf/run_inference.py --model tmp/converted.pt --seq-len 512 --batch 4
```
maria: quick sanity check of HF config shows missing "rotary_dim" and a stale "num_key_heads" field.
sophie: action items: (1) patch HF parser to infer rotary_dim from pairwise metadata but raise a warning, (2) conversion script should normalize axes and inject explicit rope_scale/rotary_dim fields into safetensors metadata, (3) add a kernel-selection unit test to catch misaligned kv dims.
eli: started a PR branch: git@repo:redwood/eng-runtime#fix/mixtralx-rotary-metadata
ajay: also adding a batching heuristic tweak — when avg_kv_size > threshold, prefer smaller batch size selection policy to avoid eviction thrash. will add a feature flag.
kevin: can we add a targeted perf test? short run that toggles rope_scale between 1.0 and 0.5 to show impact on selected kernels and latency.
perf-bot: scheduled perf run: mixtralx-rotary-check at 2249999100 (ci/perf)
maria: good. also log the safetensors metadata in our onboarding report so we don't lose this for later models.
sophie: quick note — there was an edge case in convert script where axis name "q_proj" was used instead of numeric axes; will patch to accept both.
eli: patch landed to branch, tests added for axis normalization and metadata injection.
ajay: I pushed the batching flag behind `--prefer-small-batches-on-kv-pressure` and enabled in canary for dedicated pool.
kevin: after fixes, local run shows P95 down to ~80ms and eviction_count near zero for same workload.
maria: awesome — assign follow-ups: eli (parser + convert patch), ajay (batching flag + canary), kevin (perf proof + writeup), sophie (onboarding report). I'll open a short postmortem note in /eng-runtime after canary completes.
eli: ack
ajay: ack :thumbsup:
kevin: ack
perf-bot: canary perf completed: no regression detected in 6/6 runs, baseline <-> canary diff -12% P95
